topic_name: Algebra Play: Can a Trick Read Your Mind?
title: Back where you started
description: Shows the hook trick on one number: add 3, double, take away 6, halve, and the start comes back.

title: The starting number cancels
description: Shows that after the steps the trick reaches x + 2, and taking away x always leaves 2.

title: Add 6, end on 3
description: Shows that changing the added number from 4 to 6 makes the trick always end on 3.

title: Reading the date from 291
description: Shows how subtracting 165 from the answer 291 leaves 126, whose last two digits are the day and the digit before is the month.

title: Reading the date from 1390
description: Shows that 1390 minus 165 leaves 1225, which splits into month 12 and day 25.

title: New steps, new number to subtract
description: Shows that with the steps multiply by 10, add 7, multiply by 10, add the day, the answer is 100M + 70 + D, so subtracting 70 from 1295 leaves 1225: month 12, day 25.

title: Decode a date: 1269
description: Shows the practice move on one answer: 1269 minus 165 leaves 1104, so month 11 and day 04.

title: A three row number pyramid
description: Shows the pyramid rule: each box is the sum of the two boxes directly below it.

title: Going down: subtract
description: Shows that a missing box below is the box above minus its known neighbour.

title: Letters fill the boxes we cannot reach
description: Shows the pyramid with top 60 and bottom row 12, blank, 8 with the blanks named a, b and c, and the one equation that solves it.

title: Letters for the missing boxes
description: Shows a four row pyramid with top 50 where the two missing bottom boxes are named p and q.

title: Start with the box you can fill
description: Shows a four row pyramid where the bottom right box can be filled at once, because 9 sits above 7 and that box.

title: The top from the bottom row
description: Shows the top of a three row pyramid written in terms of the bottom row letters.

title: The top without building the pyramid
description: Shows the shortcut a + 2b + c on the bottom row 4, 13, 8: the middle box counts twice, so the top is 38.

title: A calendar block in letters
description: Shows why the four dates of a 2 by 2 calendar block are a, a + 1, a + 7 and a + 8.

title: A column of three dates
description: Shows a new calendar shape, three dates one below the other, written as a, a + 7 and a + 14, with sum 3a + 21.

title: Shapes that stand for numbers
description: Shows an algebra grid of two rows with row sums 27 and 19, and the values of the square and circle.

title: An algebra grid with two shapes
description: Shows the first practice grid, two squares and a circle make 27, two circles and a square make 21, with the values found.

title: The largest product of 2, 3, 5
description: Shows that 32 × 5 = 160 beats the runner up 52 × 3 = 156.

title: Why the largest digit multiplies
description: Shows that for digits p < q < r, qp × r and rp × q share the part 10qr, and the ones part pr beats pq.

title: Place the digits 1, 3, 7
description: Shows the digit arranger at its start: three tiles and three empty slots, the 7 heading to the multiplier.

title: Reverse, subtract, divide by 9
description: Shows that reversing 47 to 74 and subtracting gives 27, which is 9 times the digit difference 3.

title: 83 minus 38
description: Shows that 83 − 38 = 45, which is 9 times the digit difference 8 − 3.

title: The tens cancel
description: Shows abc and its reverse cba in place value columns: the tens digits match and cancel, leaving 99 times (a − c).

title: A number and its reverse
description: Shows the move every practice item uses: a two digit number ab is 10a + b, its reverse is 10b + a.

title: Bicycles and tricycles
description: Shows the 20 cycles with 46 wheels: 14 bicycles and 6 tricycles, each tricycle adding one wheel.

title: Doubling and giving away
description: Shows Asha's stickers followed as x through two rounds of doubling and giving away 5.

title: Profit is income minus costs
description: Shows the lemonade stall: income ₹900 split into rent ₹200, making ₹300 and profit ₹400.

title: Four steps for a puzzle
description: Shows the four step plan for every puzzle on the cows puzzle: name, equation, solve, check.

title: Letters explain every trick
description: A three card summary of the chapter: a trick, a pyramid and a divisibility rule, each explained by one letter-number expression.
